# Ali Hasan Sheikh

> Solo software developer in Karachi, Pakistan, working UK hours (9:00 to 17:30, Monday to Friday). Builds custom CRMs, client portals, job systems, automations, AI assistants and business websites for small businesses, mainly in the UK. Every job gets a fixed price before work starts, and the client owns the code, hosting and accounts.

## Pages

- [Home](https://alihasansheikh.com/): services, how it works, about, FAQ and contact form
- [Removals company system](https://alihasansheikh.com/work/removals-system): one Laravel system for a UK removals company, from first quote to paid invoice
- [Property lead pipeline CRM](https://alihasansheikh.com/work/property-pipeline): an 18-stage lead pipeline for a UK property-buying business
- [BuilderConnect](https://alihasansheikh.com/work/builderconnect): final-year university project, a construction marketplace in Spring Boot and React
